pages.title: Chapter 4: Cold Forging Process
pages.text: §7[Cold Forging Core Flow]$(br2)Cold forging is the process of shaping metal by hammering at room temperature. The process has three main stages: stretching into sheet, processing into shape, and carving final products.

pages.title: §7[Step 1: Stretch Billet to Sheet]
pages.text: Place softened billet on anvil and left-click with stone hammer 8 times. The billet will be stretched into a metal sheet.$(br2)Action: Hold stone hammer, aim at softened billet on anvil, left-click repeatedly. Progress bar shows forging progress.$(br2)§lNote: There is a 1% chance of forging failure, dropping metal fragments instead of a sheet.
§bCopper Sheet$(br2)Forged from copper billet by 8 hammer strikes on the anvil. An intermediate product for further processing. Silver and gold sheets follow the same process.

pages.title: §7[Step 2: Process the Sheet]
pages.text: Metal sheets need two processing steps to become carveable:$(br2)$(li)Sheet → §6Curve§r: Right-click sheet on anvil with axe 1 time$(br)$(li)Curve → §6Slot§r: Right-click curve on anvil with axe 1 time$(br2)Curves are for forging axes, slots are for forging blades, carving knives, or further processing into rings, hooks, pins.
§cCopper Curve - Processed from copper sheet, used for forging axes with hammer or further processing into copper slots with axe.
§cCopper Slot - Processed from copper curve, the base for forging blades with hammer, carving knives with chisel, or further processing into rings, hooks, pins.

pages.title: §7[Step 3: Forge and Carve Final Products]
pages.text: Different products use different tools and methods:$(br2)§eForging (Hammer Left-click):$(br)$(li)Curve + Hammer 6 clicks → §6Axe Head$(br)$(li)Slot + Hammer 7 clicks → §6Sword Blade$(br2)§dCarving (Chisel Left-click):$(br)$(li)Slot + Chisel 6 clicks → §6Primitive Knife$(br)$(li)Metal Pin + Chisel 10 clicks → §6Pin Chestplate

pages.title: Controls Summary
pages.text: §aHow to operate:$(br2)$(li)Hammer Left-click - stretch billet into sheet, forge curve→axe, forge slot→blade$(br)$(li)Axe Right-click - sheet→curve, curve→slot, slot→ring→hook→pin$(br)$(li)Chisel Left-click - carve slot→knife, carve metal pin→pin chestplate
